taste:
This pizza has a pronounced sweet-savoury flavour, led by smoky BBQ sauce rather than a traditional tomato base. Roasted chicken breast and bacon give the topping its savoury balance, while mozzarella brings a softer, melting texture. The sauce is central to the overall character, so this is a better fit for someone who enjoys sweetness with meat than someone looking for a classic Italian-style pizza.

Texture comes from the contrast between tender chicken, crispy bacon and the sharp crunch of thinly sliced red onion. Served hot, the cheese and sauce sit alongside those firmer toppings. Expect bold flavours rather than a restrained, tomato-led combination.
